commit_message: Renderer: carry PBR texture inputs through model import
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B renderer foundation. Material schema v3 is followed by format-neutral IR/import wiring for packed metallic/roughness, ambient occlusion, normal scale, and occlusion strength. glTF preserves authored inputs; FBX and PMX normalize absent source semantics to generic defaults.
